journal:
The first thing I remember is the noise of the wind, it whipped at my shawl as the sand gently rattled around me. I couldn't remember how I had made it here or even where I was, but as I opened my eyes it all seemed so... familiar.

I saw before me an impossible sight, incomprehensibly large and imposing stone carved higher than any castle, bleached white as bone, and as my eyes slowly adjusted to the light, I began to make out a figure in the distance. Just beyond this impressive and ancient archway stood a man, robed in white and still against the shifting dunes.
prompt: A huge ancient stone archway in the far far distance across the sand dunes. A tiny man in the distance can be seen kneeling before it, as if grovelling. Far away perspective

music.why: A vast bone-white ancient gate in dark, empty dunes with a tiny kneeling figure and a still robed stranger feels still, uncanny and judgment-laden.
